title: Successful task status audit survives failed business COMMIT
environment: Canonical exact-SHA Spring Boot jar; disposable PostgreSQL18.6; no UAT fault injection
preconditions: Approved synthetic local task and authenticated TASK_MANAGE actor
Own disposable DB capable of installing a test-only deferred constraint trigger
steps: Create synthetic OPEN task; snapshot task and case_event rows; count TASK_STATUS_CHANGED events for targetId (zero).

In disposable DB ONLY: create function qa_task_commit_failure() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin raise exception 'QA deferred commit failure'; end $$; create constraint trigger qa_task_commit_failure after update on task deferrable initially deferred for each row execute function qa_task_commit_failure();
Read task/history and audit_event after response; drop the test-only trigger/function.
expected: 500 rollback restores task/history AND no successful TASK_STATUS_CHANGED event is committed (LD027 criterion3a).
cause: TaskService.java174 calls AuditLog.record before outer commit; AuditLog uses REQUIRES_NEW and commits success separately.
impact: Security/business audit falsely claims a status transition succeeded when task transaction rolled back. The fault injection demonstrates transaction ordering, not an anonymous exploit.
recommendation: REQUEST_CHANGES for LD027 and cross-phase LD011 audit integrity; unrelated work can continue.
remediation_owner: Claude; preserve separate authentication/denial auditing while making successful task-state audit atomic with business commit
retest_required: Exact reproduced deferred-COMMIT failure produces no success audit
Successful transition persists exactly one event
Audit-write failure rolls business state back where required
Refused/stale transitions add no SUCCESS event
